# paste-gram

> Fish shell CLI (`paste-gram`, alias `ptg`) that sends text, piped command output, files, and directories to a Telegram chat through the Bot API or, optionally, the user's personal account (MTProto). Large files and directories are compressed and split automatically.

Agents usually run bash or zsh, so call it through Fish and pass content after `--`: `fish -c 'paste-gram $argv' -- ./report.pdf`. Positional arguments take precedence over stdin, `-m` needs inline text when no terminal is available, and a non-zero exit status means the send failed.

An MCP server (`mcp-server/paste_gram_mcp.py`) exposes `send_message`, `send_files`, `list_targets`, and `check_setup` tools for MCP clients.
